title: The Hunters Hiding in Your Corners
hook: Spiders eat 400 to 800 million tons of prey a year, more than all humans.
script: Spiders eat 400 to 800 million tons of prey a year, more than all humans. Mostly insects, from flies in your kitchen to beetles in the grass. They catch it with silk spun from liquid, thread for thread tougher than steel. So how can something so small eat so much? There are so many of them that you are rarely more than a few feet from one. Their combined weight is around 25 million tons, and all of it is hunting. What would happen if every spider disappeared tomorrow? Insect numbers would likely explode, and crops and people would feel it fast.
